# Lago API Reference

> Scoped entry point for agents implementing Lago's REST API.

- [API overview and authentication](/api-reference/intro.md)
- [API standards](/api-reference/api-standards.md)
- [Pagination](/api-reference/pagination.md)
- [Rate limits](/api-reference/rate-limits.md)
- [Versioning and deprecation](/api-reference/versioning.md)
- [Structured errors](/api-reference/errors.md)
- [Same-origin OpenAPI discovery profile](/openapi.json)
- [Complete production OpenAPI specification](https://swagger.getlago.com/openapi.yaml)
- [JavaScript package metadata](https://registry.npmjs.org/lago-javascript-client/latest)
- [Python package](https://pypi.org/project/lago-python-client/)
- [Ruby package](https://rubygems.org/gems/lago-ruby-client)
- [Go module](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/getlago/lago-go-client)

Authenticate Lago Cloud requests with an organization API key in the `Authorization: Bearer` header. Keep keys server-side. Verify the target organization, environment, resource identifiers, currency, amount, and effective date before billing mutations.
